g.text: 1 function over candles · 2 afebrile ≠ well · 3 IADL fails first · 4 TUG >20 = high-risk ·
5 CFS from 2-wk baseline · 6 every fall gets workup · 7 long lie = CK/kidney · 8 aids ON
before screens · 9 delirium excluded FIRST · 10 CAM: acute+inattention+(1) · 11 PINCH
ME hunt · 12 hypoactive kills most · 13 validate feelings, not facts · 14 GDS + suicide
ask · 15 four leaks typed · 16 catheters LAST · 17 PAINAD behaviour · 18 NSAID kidney/GI,
opioids bowel plan · 19 cataract referred, wax OUT · 20 Beers: antichol/benzo/NSAID ·
21 triple whammy + sick-day rules · 22 brown bag every admission · 23 taper never
abrupt (5 classes) · 24 see abuse ALONE, report always · 25 MUST + re-feed low+slow.
COUNTDOWN: 6 wks — map 42 objectives + weak topics; 4 wks — timed past Qs +
canvas rationales; 2 wks — cards (CFS, CAM, PINCH ME, Beers, MUST, 25 points); 1 wk —
mock + sleep; eve — pack + rest; DAY — read twice, canvas-structure, cite modules, all.
FORMULA: baseline → hunt → assess (CGA) → plan → family → goals → document. Interviews:
STAR from canvas ("our falls fell 40%..."); "difficult elder?" = BPSD-as-need aloud.
PORTFOLIO CROWN: canvas + charts + QI + reflections + board photos (de-identified) +
family-meeting log + meds-MOT data. One finished elder-project outranks ten certificates.
PLEDGE: "I will see function not candles, hunt every new confusion, type every leak,
question every drug, see abuse alone, feed with company, walk my elders daily — grey
